An adult male on-screen airport security guard (S2) in a standard blue uniform with a badge and cap rushes forward from the right. Multiple suitcases race uncontrollably across the tarmac toward the massive, spinning turbine blades of the airplane engine from Shot 1. Background travelers chase after the bags in panic as hats, boarding passes, jackets, and loose papers fly wildly through the air, caught in the severe wind. Suddenly, a catastrophic failure triggers a burst of bright orange sparks, followed immediately by a massive eruption of fire and thick, black smoke billowing from the engine into the golden evening sky. The runway behind is littered with scattered luggage, debris, and spinning airport cones, while the airplane engine blazes with roaring flames in the background. non_diegetic_music: Playful orchestral comedy music featuring pizzicato strings, upbeat woodwinds, and a bouncy, energetic tempo. The orchestration steadily builds in volume and rhythmic intensity, incorporating lively brass swells and loud percussion crashes during the climax, before concluding with a sharp, punchy orchestral sting on the final frame.
